item.title: Unity and flavor: Mazatlán chefs unite at the Gastronomic Fair ‘Cooking with Purpose’
item.description: In an atmosphere of solidarity, flavor, and camaraderie, Chef Luis Osuna Vidaurri emphasized the importance of unity during the “Cooking with Purpose” Gastronomic Fair, held in Mazatlán. item.title: Searching Mothers Locate New Clandestine Grave in El Verde, Concordia

item.title: Restoration of the Walk of Fame, next to the Mazatlán Woman Monument
item.description: The project aims to restore deteriorated stars and includes a tribute to Horacio Palencia, possibly accompanied by a concert. With a planned investment of 3.5 million pesos, the Walk of Fame, located in the area where the Mazatlán Woman Monument stands, will be rehabilitated this year, Mayor Estrella Palacios Domínguez announced. item.title: Mazatlán still lacks an inclusive beach for people with disabilities
item.description: In the state’s main tourist destination, there is no beach with full accessibility; the lack of suitable spaces and the concession of viable sections limit the development of accessible tourism. item.title: Grupo Petroil promotes the film industry and Mazatlán as a filming destination
item.description: Grupo Petroil actively participated in the filming of the movie “Pimienta,” an internationally distributed production that will be filmed in various iconic locations in Mazatlán, giving the film a significant boost to tourism. With this participation, the Mazatlán-based business group fulfills its ongoing commitment to supporting culture, recreation, and the positive image of the city. item.title: They are investing in the rehabilitation of educational facilities in Mazatlán this year
item.description: The City Council has 15 education-related construction projects planned, representing an investment of 22.9 million pesos, which will be carried out throughout this year, announced Mayor Estrella Palacios Domínguez. item.title: Meet Jorge, the diver from Sánchez Taboada in Mazatlán
item.description: In the port of Mazatlán, Jorge, a diver with 16 years of experience, challenges heights of 15 meters, offering a spectacle that fuses tradition. Source: aztecasinaloa The post Meet Jorge, the diver from Sánchez Taboada in Mazatlán appeared first on The Mazatlan Post.

item.title: The Norwegian Bliss arrives this Thursday in Mazatlán with almost 6,000 people
item.description: For the second consecutive day, Mazatlán welcomed a cruise ship with nearly 6,000 passengers and crew members.
